SitePartDef.label: open precursor laboratory
SitePartDef.description: An exposed Ancient-era laboratory containing surviving precursor architecture and damaged technological evidence.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: The exposed laboratory still contains intact precursor architecture and damaged evidence. Nothing here is a free functional Ancient weapons or power system, but the site may help reconstruct the technology later.

SitePartDef.label: sealed precursor vault
SitePartDef.description: A compact sealed Ancient vault whose surviving containment evidence may illuminate precursor vacuum-energy technology.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: The vault shell is still largely intact. A degraded vacuum-containment artifact appears to have survived inside, but no complete power module is being handed to you for free.

SitePartDef.label: Ancient survey annex
SitePartDef.description: An apparently intact Ancient survey annex built around a quiet data core. The architecture looks legitimate, but the site's internal pattern density is unusual.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: The annex appears Ancient at first inspection. The central survey core remains silent. Approaching it may reveal whether the site is what it claims to be.
